sentences.text: Primapus is an extinct genus of birds belonging to the Apodiformes order, a group that includes swifts and hummingbirds.
The type species of the genus, which is the species the name is based on, is P. lacki.
This animal lived during the Early Eocene epoch, specifically between 56 and 48.07 million years ago within the Ypresian stage.
Its fossils were discovered in the London Clay, a geological formation deposited approximately 50 million years ago in the United Kingdom.
